require_relative "../../benchmarks/load"
require "active_support/notifications"

fields = Hash.new { |hash, name| hash[name] = [] }
operations = []
subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe(/\.onni\z/) do |*arguments|
  event = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*arguments)
  fields[event.name] |= event.payload.keys.map(&:to_s)
  operations << event.payload[:operation].to_s if event.payload.key?(:operation)
end
Onni::Bench::Load.with_registry! do
  Onni::Bench::Load.prepare_features!
  Onni.configuration.stats_sample_rate = 1.0
  actor = Onni::Bench::Load.actor_class.new(0, beta_tester: true)
  Onni.ready!(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.park!(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.clear!(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.ready!(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.visible_actor!(:flag_actor, actor)
  Onni.drop_actor!(:flag_actor, actor)
  Onni.visible_group!(:flag_group, :staff)
  Onni.drop_group!(:flag_group, :staff)
  Onni.level!(:flag_percentage, 0)
  Onni.variants!(:flag_variant, control: 100)
  Onni.visible?(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.visible?(:flag_percentage, actor)
  Onni.purge_stats!(older_than: Time.now + 3600)
end
ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber)
result = {"fields" => fields.transform_values(&:sort), "operations" => operations.uniq.sort, "payload_values_saved" => false}
File.write("benchmarks/output/terminology_v1_trace.json", JSON.pretty_generate(result) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(result)
auxiliary_scripts.package.rb:
require "rubygems/package"
require "open3"
require "fileutils"
require "json"
require "digest"

base = "tmp/terminology-v1/package_before"
FileUtils.mkdir_p(base)
Gem::Package.new("tmp/pressure-show-skip/packages/after/onni-0.gem").extract_files(base)
digest = Digest::SHA256.new
Dir["#{base}/{lib,app,sig}/**/*"].select { |path| File.file?(path) }.sort.each do |path|
  digest << path.delete_prefix(base) << File.binread(path)
end
expected = JSON.parse(File.read("benchmarks/output/terminology_v1_compare.json")).dig("source_digests", "before")
raise "Packaged baseline does not match the measured baseline" unless digest.hexdigest == expected
root = Dir.pwd
raw = {"before" => base, "after" => "."}.transform_values do |directory|
  Array.new(3) do |index|
    destination = File.join(root, "tmp/terminology-v1/package-#{directory == "." ? "after" : "before"}-#{index}.gem")
    _output, status = Open3.capture2e({"SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" => "1794528000"}, "gem", "build", "onni.gemspec", "--output", destination, chdir: directory)
    raise "Package build failed" unless status.success?
    {"bytes" => File.size(destination), "sha256" => Digest::SHA256.file(destination).hexdigest}
  end
end
result = {"samples" => 3, "source_date_epoch" => "1794528000", "raw" => raw,
          "summary_max_bytes" => raw.transform_values { |rows| rows.map { |row| row.fetch("bytes") }.max }}
File.write("benchmarks/output/terminology_v1_package.json", JSON.pretty_generate(result) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(result.fetch("summary_max_bytes"))
auxiliary_scripts.preview_bridge.rb:
require "rspec/core"
require_relative "../../spec/rails_helper"
require "rack/mock"
require "json"
require "fileutils"

directory = File.join(__dir__, "preview")
FileUtils.mkdir_p(directory)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: File.join(directory, "preview.sqlite3"))
ActiveRecord::Schema.verbose = false
load "spec/dummy/db/schema.rb"
Onni.reset_adapter!
Onni.register_group(:beta_testers) { |_actor, _| true }
Onni.ready!(:demo)
Onni.park!(:audience)
Onni.adapter.record_stat(:demo, shown: true, weight: 24)
Onni.adapter.record_stat(:demo, shown: false, weight: 6)
$stdout.sync = true
puts JSON.generate(ready: true)
while (line = $stdin.gets)
  request = JSON.parse(line)
  response = Rack::MockRequest.new(Rails.application).request(
    request.fetch("method"), request.fetch("url"),
    input: request.fetch("body", ""), "CONTENT_TYPE" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
    "HTTP_COOKIE" => request.fetch("cookie", "")
  )
  puts JSON.generate(status: response.status, headers: response.headers, body: response.body)
end
